summary: Phases 6 to 9 pass acceptance on 06b03ed0. A clean rebuild reproduces every delivered hash: the cut-out, the five idle sprite values, the sheet, and the panel. All eleven proportion rows and both palms pass. The Phase 9 plan claims match the files. The VM and the disk are gone. Two Major record gaps and seven Nits remain. None blocks the phase.
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Major] phase-acceptance: test-strategy.md:56 and :58 name a Security review and adversarial testing for Phases 6 and 7. No review-b result and no adversarial result exists for Phase 6 or Phase 7 (measure/runs holds review-b for Phases 2 and 4 and adversarial for Phases 2, 4 and 5). plan.md records no waiver. I checked the security facts myself: gcloud lists 0 instances and 0 disks in reading-advantage; mom-panel.png holds two Mom renders only (scripts/mom-kim-sheet.mjs:368-383, and I read the image); judge.json names family nvidia against Green hy4 and Red muse. Fix: record one waiver line for Phases 6 to 8 in plan.md that cites this result, or run the two gates. Rationale: the strategy file names these gates, and a reader cannot tell why they did not run.

F2 [Major] phase-acceptance: The commit message of bf4158a5 says the look judge failed the cut-out and the 128 px sprite before the reshape. No committed file records that failed round. plan.md T13 and T14 record the passing round only (judge-p9-bf4158a.json). I cannot check the route or family of the failed round against AC4 rule 6, which says a second judge family is not a remedy. Fix: add the failed round (route, scores, faults) to the T13 and T14 evidence. Rationale: a pass at exactly 7.5 on proportion needs its full history.

F3 [Nit] phase-acceptance: Two small blue wedges poke through the sweater hem at both hips. I confirmed them on the cut-out (about x 398 and x 625, y 870, 8 by 16 px) and in the panel and sprite views. This repeats final acceptance F7. The commit message of bf4158a5 says the jeans no longer poke through the hem. AGENTS.md requires that nothing pokes through anything. Fix: lower the jeans seat or raise the sweater hem, then rebuild and judge again. Or accept the flecks at Daniel's look gate. Rationale: any asset change moves every Phase 9 hash, so the owner decides.

F4 [Nit] phase-acceptance: trial-result.md:102-107 says the trial left one artifact: a public key in the project common metadata (ssh-keys). I confirmed that the key name ssh-keys still exists (gcloud project-info, key names only; I read no value). Neither plan.md nor tech-debt.md records the item. Fix: add one line to the T9 record or a debt row, and let the owner decide on removal. Rationale: an open security leftover needs an owner and a status.

F5 [Nit] phase-acceptance: The SHA evidence of T9 and T10 cites commits that did not deliver the file. T10 cites 2325440f (the T8r2 Green commit) and says judge.json is not in git; judge.json is tracked since 0477dbb2. T9 cites 0d4ff336 (a plan record), and trial-result.md first landed in 06b03ed0. The T10 sentence 'The panel is final unless that acceptance finds a change' is stale: the Phase 9 rebuild replaced the panel (b6cba32a to 0165b36d). Fix: cite the record commits and amend the stale clauses. Rationale: plan and commit SHA must agree.

F6 [Nit] phase-acceptance: trial-result.md:24, :30 and :31 and plan.md T9 state 'VM time: 02:00:19 to 03:02:00 = 1.036 hours'. The interval is 1 h 1 min 41 s, which is 1.028 hours. The bill stays USD 0.58 (0.5598 plus 0.0155 gives 0.575), so the cap check holds. Fix: write 1.028 hours, or name the end time that gives 1.036. Rationale: a stated count must follow from its stated inputs.

F7 [Nit] phase-acceptance: plan.md T13 and T14 cite /tmp/opencode/verify-mom-delivery.mjs for the alpha, size and ring checks. That script is not in git, and no committed test pins the cut-out or the sprite. The committed probe measure/runs/chibi_sprouts_redesign_20261123/final-acceptance-7478b2a-verify.mjs reproduces each claim. Fix: cite the committed probe. Rationale: a reader cannot rerun a scratch script.

F8 [Nit] phase-acceptance: spec.md and test-strategy.md are not amended for two plan deviations. AC6 rule 3 asks the amendment to add a walk-clip Red task and Green task; the 2026-11-25 amendment adds T13 and T14 only, and T14 defers the walk pair. AC7 rule 2 and test-strategy section 10 still name trial-log.tsv, which was lost on 2026-11-24; only plan.md T9 amends the rule. Fix: amend the two documents or cite the plan amendment in them. Rationale: the spec must match the work.

F9 [Nit] phase-acceptance: Phase 8 holds no committed record of the handoff content or the PM word. T11 says only that the PM holds the handoff. T12 gives the date, the approval, and the next task, but it names no commit (final acceptance F11, not fixed). The commit that records T12 is 817e838d. Fix: cite 817e838d on the T12 line. Rationale: the Phase 8 defense in test-strategy.md asks for a T11 record before a PM claim.
